test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

D K _ Y D _ N _ _ K N Y D _ N Y _ K N _

options.text: N K Y D K D Y
D N Y D K D D
K D Y N K Y D
K K D N Y K D

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: D K _ Y D _ N _ _ K N Y D _ N Y _ K N _

Now, put the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) N K Y D K D Y → D K **__N__** Y / D __**K**__ N __Y__ / __D__ K N Y / D __K__ N Y / __D__ K N __Y__

Here, '**DKNY**' followed a pattern. 

Option 2) D N Y D K D D → D K **__D__** Y / D __N__ N __**Y**__ / __D__ K N Y / D __K__ N Y / __D__ K N __D__

Option 3) K D Y N K Y D → D K __K__ Y / D __D__ N __Y__ / __N__ K N Y / D __K__ N Y / __Y__ K N __D__

Option 4) K K D N Y K D → D K __K__ Y / D __K__ N __D__ / __N__ K N Y / D __Y__ N Y / __K__ K N __D__

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
